goal: Iske baad aap new se heap par variable bana sakte hain, usay pointer ke zariye use kar sakte hain, delete se wapas de sakte hain, aur memory leaks aur dangling pointers se bach sakte hain.
warmup: Shaadi ke liye kiraye ke hall ka tasawwur karein. Aap jab zaroorat ho book karte hain (new), aap ko ek chaabi milti hai jis par address likha hota hai (pointer), aur jab function khatam ho jaye to aap ko hall wapas karna hota hai (delete). Agar aap hall wapas kiye baghair chaabi kho dein to koi use nahi kar sakta aur aap kiraya dete rehte hain: yeh memory leak hai. Agar aap hall wapas kar dein lekin purane address par jaate rahein to wahan ajnabi milte hain: yeh dangling pointer hai.
definition: Dynamic memory allocation ka matlab hai program chalte WAQT memory maangna. Aap ko iski zaroorat tab parti hai jab size sirf run time par pata chale (masalan user type kare ke kitne students hain), ya jab data usay banane wale function ke khatam hone ke baad bhi zinda rehna chahiye. Operator new heap se ek box leta hai aur uska address wapas deta hai, is liye aap jawab pointer mein rakhte hain. Operator delete box wapas kar deta hai. Local variables stack par rehte hain aur khud ba khud khatam ho jate hain. Heap ke boxes tab tak zinda rehte hain jab tak aap delete na karein.
howItWorks: Step 1: new int(5) heap par int ke size ki khali jagah dhoondta hai, usmein 5 rakhta hai, aur uska address wapas deta hai. Step 2: aap woh address pointer mein store karte hain, masalan int *p = new int(5);. Pointer p stack par aam variable hai. Jis box par woh point karta hai woh heap par hai. Step 3: aap box ko *p se use karte hain, bilkul aam variable ki tarah. Step 4: jab kaam khatam ho jaye, delete p; box wapas kar deta hai. delete ke baad pointer p mein purana address rehta hai, lekin box ab aap ka nahi, is liye p dangling pointer hai. Achhi aadat: delete ke foran baad p = nullptr; likhein. Yaad rakhne wale rules: har new ke liye bilkul ek delete chahiye, delete ke baad pointer kabhi use na karein, ek hi address ko do dafa delete na karein (double delete), aur kisi box ke wahid pointer ko kisi aur address se overwrite na karein, warna purana box kho jata hai (leak). Initialisation: new int; ek unknown value deta hai, new int(5); 5 deta hai, new int(); 0 deta hai.
